replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The map looks interesting but I think the cylinder path might be a bit small. I'd make it slightly wider.

You used an interesting palette with the sandstone but I'm not sure that it fits the best, Possibly should have just went with stone slabs. I also dislike the huge amount of glowstone used in the spawn room and the bottom iron room.

The gameplay could be very interesting due to the layout and placement of monuments. Looking forward to seeing more from you.

As for the YML, Avicus now uses XML but I'm sure someone will help you out and convert it. You should also use something else for uploading the XML like gist from Github. It makes it much easier for previewing as we don't have to download a file.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I'm sorry to say but your map has been denied from the Avicus Network.

Here are the reasons why:
The pathways are too narrow and need improvement
Increase space for PvP
The blocks used need more variation.

You may resubmit once completed.
